text:
mia-peopleops: Heads up everyone — Marcus (Eng) handed in resignation today. Final day 2026-04-10. Hes on company-sponsored visa and has a company phone + badge. Need to coordinate visa handoff to immigration, final comp/vesting checks, device return, and staged access removal. Looping omar (manager), julia (IT), payroll-bot, facilities, and hr-automation.

omar-manager: Confirming 2-week notice. Marcus agreed to do a knowledge-transfer session with the team on 2026-04-07 (90 mins) and to transfer ownership of the SDK repo + two runbooks. I'll collect his timesheets and any outstanding expense receipts by 2026-04-03.

julia-it: For sponsored employees follow immigration checklist; IT notes: keep Okta/Slack/GitHub active through EOD 2026-04-10 to allow handoff. Proposed deprovision window: rotate AWS keys and remove IAM roles on 2026-04-11 09:00 PT; remove GitHub org membership 2026-04-11 18:00 PT; disable Slack 2026-04-11 20:00 PT. Need asset tags and phone serial.

payroll-bot: Payroll items: final salary prorate, PTO payout, check equity vesting (there is a mid-cycle vest on 2026-04-01), COBRA packet eligibility. I need preferred delivery method for benefits docs and timesheets by 2026-04-03 to include in the 2026-04-07 payroll run.

mia-peopleops: Marcus prefers HR portal for secure docs; fallback to personal email marcus.personal+rw@gmail.com if needed. Omar please confirm timesheets.

omar-manager: I'll get timesheets and receipts by 04-03. Also will request Marcus to transfer Notion pages and change SDK repo ownership to platform-team before 04-10 EOD. Marcus agreed to an async Q&A after the handoff.

facilities: For badge/phone returns we can accept drop-off at SF office or send prepaid label for pickup. Which does Marcus prefer?

omar-manager: Marcus will be relocating after 04-05 and will need a prepaid label for the phone and badge. Please post tracking when shipped.

julia-it: Noted. Facilities please send label by 2026-04-12. IT wipe plan: once device received we erase within 24h and then mark laptop/phone deprovisioned. Post tracking + asset tag here to trigger the wipe. Also snapshot IAM keys and S3 access for audit before removal.

payroll-bot: I'll open a comp case regarding pro-rata vesting and share net/gross pay estimate by 2026-04-04. COBRA packet to be prepared by 2026-04-15.

hr-automation: Scheduling optional exit interview 2026-04-14 10:00 PT (30m). Will send calendar invite and short exit survey link.

mia-peopleops: Final checklist: timesheets by 04-03, comp case for equity, prepaid label for phone/badge, deprovision schedule (okta/git/aws/slack), repo/Notion ownership transfer, exit interview. Post updates here so we have a single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
